items.name: Fushun Open 2024
items.information:
About guest and spectators
Each player can be accompanied by one free guest, more than one guest by the need to buy tickets on site, the price of 50 RMB one person, the total number of accompanying persons (and spectators) of the competition has a limit.

items.name: It's Clocking Time Lima 2024
items.information:
Ver la pestaña [Registro](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ItsClockingTimeLima2024#36486-registro-registration) para obtener información detallada.
Además, todos los competidores deben conocer [el reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/)
Debido a cuestiones de aforo, los participantes deben evitar asistir con invitados.

See the [Registration](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ItsClockingTimeLima2024#36486-registro-registration) tab for detailed information.
Also, all competitors should be aware of [the WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)
Due to capacity limitations, participants should avoid attending with guests.

items.name: Honolulu Nui a Makapo 2024
items.information:
![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/578431091522797600/1156783553196085308/311822565_10159863148208791_5265841507458045856_n.png)
### The competition weekend in Hawai'i continues with an amazing side events competition!

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.

### This competition will be specializing in niche events and will not have 3x3 or any traditional events. If you would like to sign up for a competition involving those events, please check out [Li'ili'i a 'Ike Maka 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HonoluluLiiliiaIkeMaka2024), happening on January 27th, the day before.
